summary: Iteration 15 — Retest of the two fixes from iter14. Both RESOLVED. (1) build_xmp now escapes '"' via _xesc(str(x), {'"':'"'}) at server.py:359-360 → XMP with filename 'weird"<>&.CR3' and camera_profile 'Adobe "quoted" <x>&y' parses cleanly via ElementTree, contains " (no bare `weird"`), retains xmp:Rating=5, xmp:Label=Green, and all <>& escaped. critical_code_review_comments: Fix 1 is minimal and correct: passing entities dict to xml.sax.saxutils.escape adds '"'→'"' on top of the default &, <, > mapping. Applied at build_xmp (server.py:359-360). Note: _profile_to_xmp (lines 1220,1224-1225) still uses .replace('"',"'") which coerces quotes to apostrophes — acceptable but inconsistent; prefer the same " escape for parity.

Fix 2 is defensive but silent: get_final_selection filters non-dict items with `isinstance(x, dict)`. Consider also validating at PATCH /state (Pydantic) or returning a warning field so clients notice bad payloads. Current behavior silently drops strings — safe, but hides client bugs.
